scenes.narration: Concerts brought in 20.9 billion dollars. So why did Live Nation keep almost none of it?
It hosted 159 million fans across 55 thousand shows.
But concerts had an adjusted profit margin of just 3.3 percent.
Ticketing is the opposite, with a margin of 37 percent.
Concerts earned 0.7 billion dollars of adjusted profit, ticketing 1.1 billion, and sponsorships 0.8 billion.
Shows bring the crowd. Tickets and sponsors bring the profit. Follow for more.
